payload.rebuttal: argued: The mutation changes a strict > to >= in the single comparison (value, len(digits)) > (best[0], len(best[1])) inside seed_spec_id. For this to change the function's return value, two matched files would need to tie exactly on that pair. A fixed numeric value together with a fixed digit-string length has exactly one zero-padded decimal spelling, so an exact tie on (value, len(digits)) forces the two files' digit strings to be byte-identical too. If those two tied files also share a prefix, best ends up holding the same (value, digits, prefix) triple either way, so > and >= return the same id. If they have different prefixes, seed_spec_id already raises ValueError from the separate 'more than one prefix' check, which scans every matched file's prefix regardless of which file best points to, so the tied best is never reached or returned in that case either. There is no directory of files on which > and >= produce a different return value or a different raise outcome, so this is an equivalent mutant rather than a real gap, and I made no change for it.
